title: BackendError
description: Machine-readable error with a closed code set: unsupported, authorization_denied, budget_exhausted, version_conflict, unreachable, outcome_unknown. Timeouts and connection loss map to outcome_unknown (reconcile later) - never to an automatic task failure. version_conflict covers both contract-version mismatch outside the support window and idempotency-key reuse with different request content (mark detail_ns.reason=idempotency_key_content_mismatch and point at the original request). Every error carries a request reference and a machine-readable code; free text alone is never sufficient. HTTP binding: only unsupported/authorization_denied/budget_exhausted/version_conflict are returnable as HTTP error responses (problem+json); unreachable and outcome_unknown are caller-synthesized states, never backend HTTP errors. v0.2 adds the query_by_vendor_session reconciliation strategy for hosted backends that support session-level lookup.

detail_ns.description: Backend-specific detail namespace (e.g. capability name, idempotency conflict reason).

reconciliation.description: Present for outcome_unknown: how to reconcile without blind retry.
